heading: Who I am
text: Moeez Ahmad Khan, AI/ML Developer. I design low-latency backend APIs, autonomous multi-agent systems, and real-time computer vision pipelines, and take them from model orchestration through containerized cloud deployment. Based in Lahore, Pakistan. Contact: kmoeez2018@gmail.com. I'm currently an AI Engineer at Ecommerce Steem, where I'm building AI chat software for Whoop wearables, a computer vision platform that tracks humans and animals in real time, and automation pipelines that connect LLMs to external tools using the Model Context Protocol. Before that, I worked as an AI & Computer Vision Developer at QUIDSol, building face-identification and pitch-deck-analysis pipelines, and as a Teacher's Assistant at Information Technology University, mentoring graduate students in agentic AI. I hold a BSCS from ITU (2021–2025), specializing in agentic AI, computer vision, and reinforcement learning.

heading: Project: Project Horus
text: An automated pipeline that identifies students from live video, matching faces against an enrolled index in real time. Detects faces in real time with YOLO and SCRFD, then generates ArcFace embeddings for each detection. Matches those embeddings against a FAISS vector index to assign identity. Tuned for reliability across varied edge-case environments and high-throughput processing. Built with YOLO, SCRFD, ArcFace, FAISS.

Built with AI-driven parsing engine, Financial metric extraction.
